title: element-classifier output
description: Schema for the JSON object returned by the element-classifier subagent. The orchestrator validates every response against this schema before appending to workspace/classifications.jsonl.

element_id.description: The element_id from the input, copied verbatim. Null only in the error-fallback case.

tag.description: Level 1 — exactly one of the six classification tags.

data_category.description: Level 2 — the investment-data-category. Required, but MUST be null unless tag is data-driven-quantitative or data-driven-qualitative. See the investment-data-categories skill.

authoring_component.description: Level 2 — the Assette authoring primitive this element implies. Always set ('none' if nothing to author). See the authoring-component-identification skill.

confidence.description: Honest confidence in the classification (tag and Level-2 fields). Values below 0.7 are routed to the review queue.

rationale.description: One to three sentences explaining the classification and what would change the answer.

routing_hint.description: Optional downstream hint (system-block-candidate:*, dynamic-field-candidate:*, etc.). See skills/element-classification/SKILL.md §3.
